installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Garry's Mod x86-64 + Git - installation script
# Runs in ghcr.io/pterodactyl/installers:debian (ships git, curl, ca-certificates)
# Server files: /mnt/server

set -Eeuo pipefail

server_dir=/mnt/server
steamcmd_dir="${server_dir}/steamcmd"
egg_dir="${server_dir}/.egg"

## Steam login (anonymous by default)
if [[ -z "${STEAM_USER:-}" ]]; then
    echo "Steam user is not set, using anonymous login."
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
fi

## Download SteamCMD
mkdir -p "${steamcmd_dir}" "${server_dir}/steamapps"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 3 \
    --output /tmp/steamcmd.tar.gz \
    https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf /tmp/steamcmd.tar.gz -C "${steamcmd_dir}"
rm -f /tmp/steamcmd.tar.gz

export HOME="${server_dir}"

## Install Garry's Mod on the x86-64 branch
"${steamcmd_dir}/steamcmd.sh" \
    +force_install_dir "${server_dir}" \
    +login "${STEAM_USER}" "${STEAM_PASS:-}" "${STEAM_AUTH:-}" \
    +app_update "${SRCDS_APPID:-4020}" -beta "${SRCDS_BETAID:-x86-64}" \
    validate +quit

## Steam client libraries
install -D -m 0644 "${steamcmd_dir}/linux32/steamclient.so" "${server_dir}/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so"
install -D -m 0644 "${steamcmd_dir}/linux64/steamclient.so" "${server_dir}/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so"

## Default files (only created if missing, so a reinstall never overwrites your config)
mkdir -p "${server_dir}/garrysmod/lua/autorun/server" "${server_dir}/garrysmod/cfg"

if [[ ! -f "${server_dir}/garrysmod/lua/autorun/server/workshop.lua" ]]; then
    cat > "${server_dir}/garrysmod/lua/autorun/server/workshop.lua" <<'LUA'
-- Docs: https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/resource.AddWorkshop
-- Add the ID of each Workshop addon clients must download (addon IDs, not the collection ID).
-- Example: resource.AddWorkshop("123456789")
LUA
fi

if [[ ! -f "${server_dir}/garrysmod/cfg/server.cfg" ]]; then
    cat > "${server_dir}/garrysmod/cfg/server.cfg" <<'CFG'
// Do not set RCON here, use the startup parameters.

hostname        "New Gmod Server"
sv_password     ""
sv_loadingurl   ""
sv_downloadurl  ""

// Steam server list settings
sv_region "255"
sv_lan "0"
sv_max_queries_sec_global "30000"
sv_max_queries_window "45"
sv_max_queries_sec "5"

// Server limits
sbox_maxprops       100
sbox_maxragdolls    5
sbox_maxnpcs        10
sbox_maxballoons    10
sbox_maxeffects     10
sbox_maxdynamite    10
sbox_maxlamps       10
sbox_maxthrusters   10
sbox_maxwheels      10
sbox_maxhoverballs  10
sbox_maxvehicles    20
sbox_maxbuttons     10
sbox_maxsents       20
sbox_maxemitters    5
sbox_godmode        0
sbox_noclip         0

// Network settings - keep these at default
sv_minrate              75000
sv_maxrate              0
gmod_physiterations     2
net_splitpacket_maxrate 45000
decalfrequency          12

// Ban files - do not edit
exec banned_ip.cfg
exec banned_user.cfg

// Add custom lines below
CFG
fi

## Bundle git for the runtime image
# The official runtime image (ghcr.io/ptero-eggs/games:source) does not ship git.
# Copy this installer's git and the libraries it needs into the server folder.
# Built on Debian bullseye, so it runs fine on the bookworm-based runtime image.
bundle="${egg_dir}/git"
rm -rf "${bundle}"
mkdir -p "${bundle}/bin" "${bundle}/libexec" "${bundle}/lib"

cp -L "$(command -v git)" "${bundle}/bin/git"
ln "${bundle}/bin/git" "${bundle}/libexec/git"
cp -L /usr/lib/git-core/git-remote-http "${bundle}/libexec/git-remote-http"
ln "${bundle}/libexec/git-remote-http" "${bundle}/libexec/git-remote-https"

for binary in "${bundle}/bin/git" "${bundle}/libexec/git-remote-http"; do
    ldd "${binary}" | awk '/=> \// { print $3 }'
done | sort -u | while read -r lib; do
    case "$(basename "${lib}")" in
        # glibc is provided by the runtime image (newer, backward compatible)
        libc.so.*|libm.so.*|libdl.so.*|libpthread.so.*|librt.so.*|libresolv.so.*|libutil.so.*|ld-linux*) continue ;;
    esac
    cp -L "${lib}" "${bundle}/lib/"
done
cp -L /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt "${bundle}/ca-certificates.crt"

LD_LIBRARY_PATH="${bundle}/lib" GIT_EXEC_PATH="${bundle}/libexec" "${bundle}/bin/git" --version
echo "Bundled git ready ($(du -sh "${bundle}" | cut -f1))."

## Runtime sync script, run by the startup command before the server starts
cat > "${egg_dir}/git-sync.sh" <<'SYNC'
#!/bin/bash
# Pre-start Git sync. Any failure is reported but never prevents the server from starting.

[[ "${AUTO_GIT_UPDATE:-0}" == "1" ]] || exit 0
cd /home/container || exit 0

log() { printf '\033[1m\033[36m[git-sync]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }

bundle=/home/container/.egg/git
if [[ ! -x "${bundle}/bin/git" ]]; then
    log "Bundled git not found. Reinstall the server to restore it. Skipping."
    exit 0
fi

export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="${bundle}/lib" GIT_EXEC_PATH="${bundle}/libexec"
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_HTTP_LOW_SPEED_LIMIT=1000 GIT_HTTP_LOW_SPEED_TIME=30
[[ -f /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt ]] || export GIT_SSL_CAINFO="${bundle}/ca-certificates.crt"
git() { "${bundle}/bin/git" -c safe.directory='*' "$@"; }

folder=${GIT_FOLDER:-.}
if [[ "${folder}" = /* || "${folder}" == *..* ]]; then
    log "GIT_FOLDER must be a relative path without '..'. Skipping."
    exit 0
fi
if [[ ! -d "${folder}/.git" ]]; then
    log "No Git repository in '${folder}'. Set a Git Repository and reinstall the server first. Skipping."
    exit 0
fi

if [[ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS:-}" ]]; then
    address=${GIT_ADDRESS}
    [[ "${address}" == *.git ]] || address="${address}.git"
    git -C "${folder}" remote set-url origin "${address}" 2>/dev/null \
        || git -C "${folder}" remote add origin "${address}"
fi

if [[ -n "${USERNAME:-}" && -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
    askpass=$(mktemp)
    trap 'rm -f "${askpass}"' EXIT
    printf '#!/bin/sh\ncase "$1" in *sername*) printf "%%s\\n" "$GIT_USERNAME" ;; *) printf "%%s\\n" "$GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN" ;; esac\n' > "${askpass}"
    chmod 700 "${askpass}"
    export GIT_ASKPASS="${askpass}" GIT_USERNAME="${USERNAME}" GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN="${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
fi

log "Fetching ${BRANCH:-default branch}..."
if git -C "${folder}" fetch --depth=1 origin "${BRANCH:-HEAD}"; then
    if git -C "${folder}" reset --hard FETCH_HEAD; then
        log "Up to date: $(git -C "${folder}" log -1 --format='%h %s')"
    else
        log "Checkout failed, keeping current files."
    fi
else
    log "Fetch failed, keeping current files."
fi
exit 0
SYNC
chmod 755 "${egg_dir}/git-sync.sh"

## Clone or update the Git repository (only if one is set)
if [[ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS:-}" ]]; then
    echo "No Git repository set, skipping Git deployment."
    echo "Installation complete."
    exit 0
fi

git_folder=${GIT_FOLDER:-}
if [[ "${git_folder}" = /* || "${git_folder}" == *..* ]]; then
    echo "GIT_FOLDER must be a relative path without '..'." >&2
    exit 1
fi
git_target="${server_dir}${git_folder:+/${git_folder}}"
mkdir -p "${git_target}"

git_address=${GIT_ADDRESS}
[[ "${git_address}" == *.git ]] || git_address="${git_address}.git"

export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
if [[ -n "${USERNAME:-}" && -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
    askpass=$(mktemp)
    trap 'rm -f "${askpass}"' EXIT
    cat > "${askpass}" <<'ASKPASS'
#!/bin/sh
case "$1" in
    *sername*) printf '%s\n' "$GIT_USERNAME" ;;
    *) printf '%s\n' "$GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN" ;;
esac
ASKPASS
    chmod 700 "${askpass}"
    export GIT_ASKPASS="${askpass}" GIT_USERNAME="${USERNAME}" GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN="${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
fi

# Credentials are never written into the remote URL or .git/config.
git -C "${git_target}" init -q
git -C "${git_target}" remote remove origin 2>/dev/null || true
git -C "${git_target}" remote add origin "${git_address}"
git -C "${git_target}" fetch --depth=1 origin "${BRANCH:-HEAD}"
git -C "${git_target}" checkout -f -B deployed FETCH_HEAD

echo "Repository deployed into ${git_target}."
echo "Installation complete."

variables.name: Map
variables.description: Map loaded when the server starts.

variables.name: Steam Account Token
variables.description: Game Server Login Token (GSLT), required for the server to show in the public list. Create one at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers (App ID 4000).

variables.name: Steam Beta Branch
variables.description: Do not modify: srcds_run_x64 only exists on the x86-64 branch.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description:
Update the game through SteamCMD on every start.
0 = off, 1 = on.

variables.name: Workshop Collection ID
variables.description: ID of your Steam Workshop collection (the number at the end of its URL). Leave empty for none.

variables.name: Gamemode
variables.description: Gamemode of the server (e.g. sandbox, darkrp, terrortown).

variables.name: Tickrate
variables.description: How many times per second the server simulates the game.

variables.name: Lua Refresh
variables.description:
Reload Lua files automatically when they change (for development, costs performance).
0 = off, 1 = on.

variables.name: Git Repository
variables.description:
Repository deployed on install/reinstall. Leave empty to disable Git.
Example: https://github.com/USER/REPO

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch to deploy. Leave empty for the repository's default branch.

variables.name: Git Folder
variables.description: Where the repository is deployed. Leave empty for the server root (/home/container), or a relative path such as garrysmod.

variables.name: Git Auto Update
variables.description:
Fetch the branch and sync tracked files before each start. Local changes to tracked files are overwritten; untracked files are kept.
0 = off, 1 = on.

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description:
Token for private repositories. Use a read-only Personal Access Token, never your account password.
GitHub: https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens
GitLab: https://gitlab.com/-/user_settings/personal_access_tokens
